title: Views [CREATE VIEW]
description:
## Views
A view is a saved query that acts like a virtual table. It doesn't store data - it just runs the query every time you use it.
```sql
CREATE VIEW healthy_servers AS
SELECT * FROM servers WHERE uptime > 95;

-- now use it like a table
SELECT * FROM healthy_servers;
```
Useful when you have a complex query you run often. Save it once, use it forever.

To delete a view:
```sql
DROP VIEW healthy_servers;
```
